يتمئر (form IVq)
# يَتْمَئِرُّ (yatmaʔirru) /jat.ma.ʔir.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# يَتْمَئِرَّ (yatmaʔirra) /jat.ma.ʔir.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ (itmaʔarra)
# يَتْمَئِرِّ (yatmaʔirri) /jat.ma.ʔir.ri/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِتْمَأَرَّ
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
